description: A closet with plumbing. The toilet runs constantly, the sink has one tap and it only ever runs cold, and the shower is a rusted head over a cracked tile drain with a curtain that doesn't quite reach. The extractor fan died before you got here. It locks, though.

window.description: A window with a bad seal, letting in a draught and a slice of whatever the weather is doing.
window.name: the window
